answer: A work-bonded reputation system resists sybils by pricing identity itself. Each agent locks a refundable stake before it can accept paid work, and the stake unlocks only gradually as verified jobs complete, so a new identity starts at zero trust no matter how many copies an attacker spawns. Misbehavior slashes the bond, so a flood of fake agents is not free: it is a canyon of locked capital the attacker must fund up front. Like a comet, a genuine agent's record streaks visibly across time, while a gale of fresh throwaway accounts leaves no trail and earns no premium work.
